signal_watch.summary: Terminal coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode can now each run in their own isolated Vercel Sandbox , orchestrated from Herdr , a tmux-style manager that runs them side by side in panes. clusters.title: Give every agent in Herdr its own Vercel Sandbox
clusters.summary: Terminal coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode can now each run in their own isolated Vercel Sandbox , orchestrated from Herdr , a tmux-style manager that runs them side by side in panes. Nothing an agent runs or edits touches your machine. When you start an agent, the plugin uploads your project files into a new Sandbox, installs the agent there, and opens a pane connected to it.
